run.procedureSummary: Five cycles. Each step runs across all six chambers before the next step starts. (1) Feed: add the cycle's row to each chamber and ignore limits. (2) Carry forward: go through chambers 1 to 6 in order. Any amount above a chamber's holding limit goes into the next chamber before that chamber is checked. Chamber 6's excess goes to the loss tally. (3) State check on the contents after carry: a LARVAL chamber at or above its upper mark becomes PUPAL; a PUPAL chamber at or below its lower mark becomes LARVAL; log each change. (4) Metabolism: every amount comes from a snapshot taken before the step, using the states just set. A LARVAL chamber loses floor(q/4) to the tally. A PUPAL chamber sends floor(q/2) to the chamber before it (chamber 1 sends its half to the tally). All movements are applied at once, and any overfill stays until the next carry. (5) Moult: if the line total is strictly over 38, every chamber becomes floor(q/2) and the amount removed (q - floor(q/2)) goes to the tally.

openPoints.assumption: The states set by this cycle's state check, since the state check comes first.

openPoints.point: Metabolism when a chamber gives and receives in the same step
openPoints.assumption: Each chamber's own loss or transfer is worked out from its pre-step contents, so mass received from the next chamber has no effect on the giving chamber's own amount. All changes are applied together.

openPoints.point: Where carried excess goes and when
openPoints.assumption: It is added to the next chamber before that chamber's own limit check, so excess can pass along several chambers in one sweep. Chamber 6's excess goes to the tally.
The amount kept is floor(q/2) and the amount removed is q - floor(q/2), which takes the odd unit. The removed amount goes to the tally.
Strictly over 38, read from the line total after metabolism. A total of exactly 38 in cycle 5 did not fire.
Both marks are inclusive ('at or above' the upper mark, 'at or below' the lower mark), checked on contents after carry. A chamber changes state at most once per cycle.
Contents above the holding limit after metabolism or moult are not carried until the next cycle. After cycle 5 they stay as they are (chamber 2 ends at 10 against a limit of 8).

run.balanceCheck: Starting mass 20 + all feed 94 = 114; end mass 38 + loss tally 76 = 114. Balanced.
